project_type: Next.js 16.3.6 App Router with React 19, pnpm monorepo, photobooth kiosk app
build_system: Next.js build system via pnpm workspaces. Root package.json delegates to workspace packages.
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests (apps/web/package.json shows vitest scripts)
build_command: pnpm build:web (from root) or pnpm build (from apps/web)
test_command: pnpm test (from apps/web) or pnpm test:watch for watch mode
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm typecheck to verify TypeScript. 2. Run pnpm dev:web from repo root to start dev server on localhost:3000. 3. Navigate through booth flow manually to test loading states. 4. For admin, visit /admin/pin and verify immediate keyboard input.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this task — no snapshot updates or generated code to commit
environment_constraints: Dev server runs on port 3000 by default. In dev mode, Next.js compiles routes on-demand which can take 2-5 seconds per route, causing the perceived lag this task addresses.
contribution_requirements: Read AGENTS.md first. Next.js 16 has breaking changes — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. Preserve all existing behavior, no feature changes, no style changes. All booth pages are client components. DoodleButton extends standard button props.
key_patterns: Booth pages use router.push() from next/navigation for navigation. All booth components are 'use client'. i18n strings via @/i18n/id. DoodleButton component accepts disabled prop. Admin pages use standard HTML/Tailwind, not doodle styling.
directory_structure: apps/web/app/(booth)/ contains the photobooth flow pages (idle, consent, frames, capture, preview, composing, end). apps/web/app/admin/ contains admin dashboard pages. apps/web/components/doodle/ has the DoodleButton and DoodleBorder components. apps/web/lib/ has utility modules. Root package.json scripts delegate to workspace packages via pnpm filters.
